selections.comment: Those with experience don't set the bar too high and big runs from a couple of the newcomers can be expected. None more so than GREAT PROFIT, a colt by Profitable costing £360,000 at the breeze-up sales, representing the Richard Fahey team who had a 2yo winner earlier this week, who could prove up to the task on debut. Major Neigh Sayer, a valuable purchase and an early foal is another who could make a splash on debut but may find Fortification and Star Material too good at this stage. Fortification was heavily backed on debut (sent of odds-on favourite,) but failed to quite deliver on that occasion. He should be in the mix but the one who sets the standard is Star Material who left a disappointing debut well behind when narrowly denied at Pontefract last time when sent off favourite. He can give the selection most to do

William Haggas's filly has progressed with each run and looks to have conditions in her favour to go one better than last time when not beaten far trying 1m4f for the first time. The form of that race has been franked by the third that day winning since and she should go very close here dropped back a furlong or so. Ritaan poses a threat based on a decent debut effort and can get in the frame but will need to take a big step forward to land this and the best alternative to the selection looks likely to be Sweet Princess, a daughter to Sea Ther Stars representing top connections who should be primed for a big effort on debut

selections.comment: Poet's Dawn has been going pretty well of late and got within a length last time back at a mile. He looks poised to go close again with nothing to fear from any rain over a course he's gone close over before but he may have to settle for minor honours behind ASTRONOMICA who got very comeptitive in three turf handicaps to end last season and could gain a first victory since July 2023. She won off a similar layoff that year and a chance is taken she can strike again now there's a bit of ease in ground (flopped on fast ground on season bow last term), with any further rain probably enhancing prospects. The are doubts over some of the other key protoganists like Mr Jetman, up in grade, Saisons D'Or, still to prove stamina at this trip and Northbound, needs to bounce back from a poor run last time so Overlooked may be a bit of value to make the frame ahead of those now returned to turf

selections.comment: MART, due to go up 3lb next time, has solid claims to land a double. The biggest query is the ground. His best turf efforts have come on decent ground (two wins on good, one on fast) but he's relatively unexposed on easy ground and all four runs on it have been close to par at least. Dylan Cunha's gelding should go very close. Emperor Caradoc looks the biggest danger having won last time out in a similar event on fast ground. He can cope with any easing of the ground and is entitled to be in the shake-up. Dicko The Legend could fight out the finish but any rain would hinder his prospects and Lord Abama looks a more solid option from the front and is entitled to go close but Animate is of more interest back on easier ground and is expected to bounce back to something near his best, which puts him firmly in contention, while any further easing of the ground would enhance his chance

Herakles must have a chance given he ran this race last year off a 9lb higher mark but has shown very little since a second six starts back in October and disappointed again last time back over this course and distance when only 6th of 7 despite attracting fair support. The most solid, but still pretty shaky, is Jojo Rabbit who has shown a bit more than most of late and may appreciate a bit of give back on turf. However, a chance is taken with the most unexposed in the field, CHIEF OF STATE. Ben Haslam's gelding was only 9th of 10 on reappearance but that came over 6f and he didn't stay. His second run last term in a maiden was a decent effort (8th of 13) in the contexct of this race and a mark of 59 looks generous based on that. He won't get many better opportunities than this

selections.comment: Precious Spartan is aiming for a course and distance double having sluiced in last time by 4.5l on good ground with a much improved effort. If in similar mood he'll be tough to beat off a 6lb rise but that victory was a bit of a shock and constituted a big step forward. A repeat is not guaranteed and any further easing of the ground would be a concern given two poor efforts on soft ground in the past. He's likely to have little juice in his price this time and on balance can be taken on. Flamborough Head has the form to go close and can bounce back returned to a mile. He's a solid enough alternative but a chance is take with EPICURIAN LAD in a first time visor. He has to bounce back from a poor effort on quick ground last time but showed plenty over course and distance prior making good late headway having been left a lot to do to see out the step up in trip. Now with greater confidence at the trip he can get his head in front for the first time
